title: refactor(Formalism/SharpRestriction/GrowthBounds): share upper-bound restGeom proof between GeOldest and OneSidedLemma4Realisable
body:
Generalize `Formalism.MainNotions.G.symbolGeneratorData.restGeom` in `GeOldest.lean` to the upper-bound-only statement `Formalism.MainNotions.G.symbolGeneratorData.restGeom_of_le`, and delegate both `restGeom` and `Formalism.MainNotions.TestSideCounting.restGeomU` in `OneSidedLemma4Realisable.lean` to it.

Changed declarations:
- Added `Formalism.MainNotions.G.symbolGeneratorData.restGeom_of_le` in `GeOldest.lean`.
- Delegated `Formalism.MainNotions.G.symbolGeneratorData.restGeom` in `GeOldest.lean` and `Formalism.MainNotions.TestSideCounting.restGeomU` in `OneSidedLemma4Realisable.lean` to `restGeom_of_le`.
